theater: 安納托利亞中部薩卡里亞戰線

battle.name: 土耳其獨立戰爭
battle.theater: 安納托利亞中部薩卡里亞戰線
battle.brief: 1919年5月薩姆松登陸揭開安納托利亞國民運動，國民軍以德製Gew 88栓動步槍組成步兵主力，憑縱深塹壕同集中砲兵頂住希軍攻勢，1922年8月大攻勢扭轉戰局，逼希軍退出小亞細亞，最終通向洛桑條約同共和國成立。

kit.name: Gew 88步槍
kit.history: 德國於1888年定型的委員會步槍，後續由德軍以Gew 98替換後大量軍援鄂圖曼帝國。鄂圖曼軍於一戰結束後將其移交土耳其國民軍，土耳其共和國成立後繼續改良使用，服役期延伸至1940年代前後，於土耳其獨立戰爭期間為民族主義部隊可見的制式栓動步槍之一。

countries: 交戰方大致分成三層。安納托利亞國民運動一方，由Mustafa Kemal Atatürk於1919年5月19日在薩姆松登陸後整合的地方武裝起步，1919年7月23日至8月4日召開埃爾祖魯姆大會，9月4日至11日召開西瓦斯大會並選舉阿塔圖爾克為全軍總司令，1920年4月16日遷往安卡拉，1921年4月23日組成安卡拉政府，大國民議會同日召開第一次會議，軍隊、財政同外交由安卡拉集中。同盟方面有蘇俄：1920年3月16日《蘇俄與土耳其條約》之後，1920年11月巴庫蘇維埃以莫辛-那丹特步槍同彈藥援助安卡拉政府；德國亦應安卡拉請求派駐軍事顧問團，由漢斯·馮·澤克主導，改組參謀總部同後勤體制。對手方第一層是希臘王國，國王康士坦丁一世坐鎮安納托利亞，野戰軍分為色雷斯軍團同伊茲密爾集團軍，指揮系統採西歐式參謀本部，另有少量英法部隊協同作戰。第二層是君士坦丁堡的鄂圖曼朝廷，即所謂帕拉內閣，靠英法海軍同駐紮部隊維持殘餘權力。第三層是法國在南部西里西亞的佔領區，以及法國委任統治下得到法軍支持同武裝化的亞美尼亞團體。英國佔領君士坦丁堡及部分安納托利亞南岸，官方宣稱中立，實際處處向希方傾斜。
countriesEn: Three layers of belligerents took part. The Anatolian national movement side began as locally raised bands that Mustafa Kemal Atatürk started to combine after he landed at Samsun on 19 May 1919; the Erzurum Congress of 23 July to 4 August 1919 and the Sivas Congress of 4 to 11 September 1919 turned it into a congress-based national organisation, elected Atatürk commander-in-chief of the army, moved the seat to Ankara on 16 April 1920, and on 23 April 1921 proclaimed the Ankara Government with the Grand National Assembly convening the same day, so that command, finance and diplomacy were concentrated in Ankara. Its allies were Soviet Russia, which after the Soviet-Turkish treaty of 16 March 1920 delivered Mosin-Nagant rifles and ammunition to Ankara from the Baku Soviet in November 1920, and Germany, which sent a military mission at Ankara's request, headed by Hans von Seeckt, to rebuild the general staff and the logistics system. The first hostile layer was the Kingdom of Greece: King Constantine I took charge of the Anatolian theatre, the field army split into the Army of Thrace and the Army of Smyrna, the command system followed a Western European general staff pattern, and a small number of British and French units cooperated. The second hostile layer was the Ottoman court in Constantinople, the so-called Pala cabinet, sustained by the British and French navies and by garrison troops. The third was the French occupation zone in Cilicia in the south, together with the Armenian formations that were armed and supported by France under the French mandate. Britain occupied Constantinople and parts of the southern Anatolian shore, declared itself neutral in form, and in practice leaned toward the Greek side.
people: 土方核心是Mustafa Kemal Atatürk。他1919年5月19日乘Bandırma號抵達薩姆松，以軍事代表身分開始全省巡查，隨後在埃爾祖魯姆與西瓦斯兩次大會上取得最高領導權，1920年4月當選大國民議會主席，薩卡里亞戰役期間駐紮安卡拉近郊Kocatepe觀察所直接指揮全局，1922年8月26日發動大攻勢，戰後出任共和國第一任總統。參謀總長İsmet İnönü由安卡拉政府的軍事參謀長升為全軍總參謀長，策劃薩卡里亞的消耗戰同大攻勢的作戰計劃，後來代表安卡拉政府簽訂穆達尼亞停戰協議並出席洛桑會議。參謀總部長Fevzi Çakmak在1921至1922年間以將軍身份主持總參謀部，是德式參謀制度的引進者。大攻勢中，Şükrü Naili率領第二騎兵軍團，即通稱的蘇梅爾兵團，負責戰役追擊；Ali Fuat Cebesoy在西部戰線同突尼斯境內遊擊；Kazım Karabekir在東部戰線接收埃爾祖魯姆、卡爾斯等要塞；Refet Bele參與西瓦斯大會並出任安卡拉軍事法庭主席。希臘方面，國王康士坦丁一世自1920年起兼任安納托利亞戰區總指揮，之後由陸軍部長尼克拉奧斯·普拉斯塔拉斯實際統兵，亞歷山德羅斯·帕帕戈斯在薩卡里亞前線指揮希軍，Ioannis Metaxas統率色雷斯方向同後方。君士坦丁堡方面以Damar Ferid Pasha組成的帕拉內閣同蘇丹穆罕默德六世為代表。
peopleEn: The central figure on the Turkish side was Mustafa Kemal Atatürk. He reached Samsun aboard the Bandırma on 19 May 1919 as a military representative, began a tour of the province, and took the highest control of the movement at the Erzurum and Sivas congresses; in April 1920 he was elected president of the Grand National Assembly, and during the Battle of Sakarya he watched the whole front from the Kocatepe observation post outside Ankara before launching the Great Offensive on 26 August 1922, later becoming the first president of the republic. İsmet İnönü rose from military chief of staff of the Ankara Government to full chief of the general staff, planned the attritional battle of Sakarya and the operational plan of the offensive, and later signed the Mudanya armistice for the Ankara Government and attended the Lausanne conference. Fevzi Çakmak headed the general staff as a general between 1921 and 1922 and was the introducer of the German-style staff system. In the offensive Şükrü Naili commanded the 2nd Cavalry Corps, known as the Sümer corps, in the pursuit; Ali Fuat Cebesoy fought on the western front and in Tunisia; Kazım Karabekir on the eastern front took Erzurum, Kars and other fortresses; Refet Bele took part in the Sivas Congress and presided over the Ankara military court. On the Greek side King Constantine I served from 1920 as overall commander in Anatolia, after which actual field command was exercised by the war minister Nikolaos Plastiras, with Alexandros Papagos commanding the Greek front at Sakarya and Ioannis Metaxas holding Thrace and the rear areas. In Constantinople the relevant figures were the Pala cabinet under Damar Ferid Pasha and Sultan Mehmed VI.
kits: 卡面這件德國Gew 88步槍是國民軍步兵的骨幹。它是七點九二公釐毛瑟彈的栓動步槍，彈匣固定在機匣底部，容量五發，連刺刀約四公斤，瞄具刻度上限八百公尺，瞄準射擊每分鐘約十發。它1888年定型，德軍在一戰後改用Gew 98，龐大庫存連同戰時交付鄂圖曼帝國的批次流散各地；安卡拉政府接收首都軍械庫同軍械工廠之後，這批七點九二公釐步槍就成了國民軍最早、最不缺件的制式槍械，與鄂圖曼時期的Mauser 1893、1905型共用同一彈藥池，意味住不同年份、不同來源的步槍可以互相補足。缺點一樣明顯：五發固定彈匣每次只打五發，射擊節奏要靠壓入彈夾、推回機匣慢慢恢復，火力密度遠不及後來直盒式供彈的步槍；大量消耗之後，老舊槍管同膛線的精度亦會下降。全軍彈藥供應的真正瓶頸不在槍，而是把彈藥由火車站送到前線分發點的路線。與Gew 88並列的還有英國援助鄂圖曼的短彈匣李-恩菲爾德步槍同1915式步槍、奧匈的Roth-Steyr M1888手動步槍同鄂圖曼自購的維特利M1870、蘇俄援助的莫辛-那丹特M1891同捷克製M1891/30，以及少量日制三八式步槍；這些槍分屬七點六二、七點九二同七點六五公釐三種口徑，彈藥分庫存放。機槍以德製MG08/15水冷式為主，另有奧製Schwarzlose M1907/12七點九二水冷重機槍。火炮沿用鄂圖曼軍的七十七公釐野戰砲同一百零五公釐榴彈砲，另繳獲敵方同型火砲湊成砲兵隊；迫擊砲同擲彈筒多為戰壕繳獲品。運輸靠馬匹、騾車同駱駝，攻城無大砲，全靠步砲射程同縱深射擊。
kitsEn: The German Gewehr 88 shown on the card is the backbone of the nationalist infantry. It is a bolt-action rifle chambered in 7.92 mm Mauser, with a fixed five-round magazine in the receiver, a length of about four kilograms with the bayonet, a rear sight graduated up to eight hundred metres, and a rate of fire of roughly ten aimed rounds per minute. The design was fixed in 1888; after the German army replaced it with the Gewehr 98, huge stocks, together with the batches delivered to the Ottoman Empire during the war, circulated widely, and once the Ankara Government took over the capital's arsenals and ordnance works this 7.92 mm rifle became the earliest and least scarce service weapon of the national army, sharing the same ammunition pool with the Ottoman-era Mauser 1893 and 1905 patterns, so that rifles of different dates and origins firing the same cartridge could make up for each other. The drawbacks are just as plain: the five-round fixed magazine gives only five shots between reloads, the firing rhythm depends on the slow business of pushing ammunition strips and the magazine bolt back into place, and the rate of fire falls well short of later box-magazine feed; after heavy use the old barrels and rifling also lose accuracy. The real bottleneck for the whole army was not the rifle but the route by which ammunition travelled from the railway stations to the distributing points at the front. Alongside the Gewehr 88 the national forces used the British short magazine Lee-Enfield and the 1915 pattern rifle, the Austro-Hungarian Roth-Steyr M1888 and the Ottoman-bought Vetterli M1870, the Soviet-supplied Mosin-Nagant M1891 and Czech-made M1891/30, and a few Japanese Arisaka rifles; these fell into three calibres, 7.62, 7.92 and 7.65 millimetres, and their ammunition was kept in separate depots. Machine guns were mostly German MG08/15 water-cooled types, with the Austro-Hungarian Schwarzlose M1907/12 as a heavy water-cooled 7.92 mm alternative. Artillery was the Ottoman 77 mm field gun and 105 mm howitzer, with captured pieces added to the batteries; mortars and trench mortars were largely taken from the enemy. Transport depended on horses, mule teams and camels, and there was no heavy siege artillery, so the artillery fight was settled by field gun range and depth of fire.
tactics: 戰爭分三個階段，戰術形態完全不同。1919至1920年是地方武裝的游擊期：隊伍人數少、裝備雜，靠伏擊同襲擾破壞希軍交通線，1919年6月班迪爾馬的攻擊雖被擊退，卻證明基層武力可以同正規軍交鋒。1921年希軍反攻奪取埃斯凱希爾、屈塔希亞之後，國民軍放棄進攻轉入塹壕防禦，藉1921年4月20日的國防權法取得兵源同徵召，於薩卡里亞河兩岸構築縱深約三十至四十公里的突出部，配置觀察所、反斜面射擊陣地同機動預備隊，盡量避免同希軍正面糾纏，靠陣地消耗敵攻勢，之後以馬匹同卡車維持安卡拉至埃斯凱希爾一線的補給。1922年8月26日大攻勢改採全線主動出擊：二十一個軍同時發起攻擊，突破希軍陣地後以中央集團向陶盧皮納爾方向縱深穿插，切斷希軍退路，再用騎兵軍團實施戰役追擊。兵種配合上，砲兵集中射擊希軍集結地同道路，機槍封鎖突破口，騎兵遮蔽翼側，突擊兵反覆衝擊縱深據點。安納托利亞東線的補給靠埃斯凱希爾至安卡拉的鐵路同公路，火車把砲彈、彈藥、糧食由安卡拉運到前線卸載站，再以馬車、騾車、駱駝分送至各軍。在炎熱乾旱的中央安納托利亞，糧秣同飲水是比彈藥更緊的約束，飲水靠井同村莊徵發。
tacticsEn: The war fell into three phases with quite different tactical shapes. From 1919 to 1920 the national side fought a partisan war: small bands with mixed equipment hit Greek supply lines by ambush and harassment; the attack at Bandırma in June 1919 was thrown back, yet it showed that the local forces could engage a regular army. After the Greek counter-offensive of 1921 took Eskişehir and Kütahya, the national army abandoned the offensive, went over to trench warfare, used the defence law of 20 April 1921 to obtain men and conscription, and built a salient thirty to forty kilometres deep on both banks of the Sakarya, with observation posts, reverse-slope firing positions and mobile reserves, avoiding close engagement and wearing down the Greek attacks by position; supplies were then kept moving on the Eskisehir to Ankara line by horse and truck. The Great Offensive of 26 August 1922 changed to a general attack by the whole army: twenty-one corps struck at once, broke through the Greek line, drove the central group in depth toward Dumlupınar to cut the Greek retreat, and the cavalry corps carried out the operational pursuit. In combined-arms terms artillery concentrated fire on Greek assembly areas and roads, machine guns sealed the penetrations, cavalry screened the flanks, and assault troops struck depth positions again and again. Supply on the eastern Anatolian line depended on the railway and the road between Eskişehir and Ankara; trains carried shells, ammunition and rations from Ankara to the unloading stations in front, and from there horse carts, mule carts and camels carried them out to the corps. In the hot, dry central Anatolian plateau, food and above all water were a tighter constraint than ammunition, and the units drew water from wells and from the villages.
data: 時間線可以逐點對照：1919年5月15日希軍在伊茲密爾登陸，5月19日阿塔圖爾克抵達薩姆松；1919年7月23日至8月4日埃爾祖魯姆大會，9月4日至11日西瓦斯大會；1920年6月希軍占領埃德雷內；1921年4月16日國民議會通過宣言，4月23日安卡拉政府成立；1922年8月23日至9月13日薩卡里亞戰役共22日，8月26日大攻勢發動，8月30日陶盧皮納爾戰役，9月9日收復伊茲密爾，9月12日希軍伊茲密爾集團軍解散；10月11日簽訂穆達尼亞停戰協議；1923年7月24日《洛桑條約》簽署，10月29日共和國成立。兵力方面，希臘在安納托利亞的野戰部隊在1921年高峰約十二萬至十五萬人；國民軍在大攻勢前集結約二十五萬七千人，官方公佈的進攻序列為二十一個軍、二千三百一十九門砲、一千零五十挺機槍、一千二百輛汽車同數百輛裝甲車，全部靠火車、馬車同騾隊輸送。損失方面，土耳其官方在薩卡里亞公佈陣亡5,718人、負傷11,878人、失蹤351人；希軍自報陣亡逾兩萬、負傷約四萬五、被俘約一萬人。陶盧皮納爾之後希軍被俘同投降者以萬計，其野戰砲、汽車同大批彈藥成為國民軍的繳獲。縱深方面，由薩卡里亞追擊到伊茲密爾的推進在九日內跨越數百公里，糧秣消耗同水源距離就是極限。
dataEn: The timeline can be checked point by point: the Greek landing at İzmir on 15 May 1919; Atatürk's arrival at Samsun on 19 May; the Erzurum Congress of 23 July to 4 August 1919; the Sivas Congress of 4 to 11 September 1919; the Greek capture of Edirne in June 1920; the declaration of independence passed by the National Assembly on 16 April 1921 and the Ankara Government formed on 23 April; the Battle of Sakarya from 23 August to 13 September 1922, twenty-two days; the Great Offensive launched on 26 August; the Battle of Dumlupınar on 30 August; the recapture of İzmir on 9 September; the dissolution of the Greek Army of Smyrna on 12 September; the Mudanya armistice signed on 11 October; the Treaty of Lausanne signed on 24 July 1923; and the proclamation of the republic on 29 October 1923. On strength, the Greek field forces in Anatolia reached roughly 120,000 to 150,000 men at their 1921 high, while the national army massed about 257,000 men before the Great Offensive, with the officially published order of battle listing twenty-one corps, 2,319 guns, 1,050 machine guns, 1,200 motor vehicles and several hundred armoured cars, all moved by train, cart and mule team. On losses, Turkey officially published 5,718 dead, 11,878 wounded and 351 missing at Sakarya, while the Greeks reported more than 20,000 dead, about 45,000 wounded and roughly 10,000 captured. After Dumlupınar the prisoners and surrenders ran into the tens of thousands, and the Greek field guns, lorries and great quantities of ammunition fell into nationalist hands. In depth, the pursuit from Sakarya to İzmir covered several hundred kilometres in nine days, with fodder consumption and the distance to water marking the limit.
cause: 直接導火線是安納托利亞的佔領問題。一戰停火之後，鄂圖曼帝國境內的希臘族裔地區被協約國瓜分，1919年5月15日希臘軍在英國、法國同意大利海軍掩護下登陸伊茲密爾，土耳其民族主義者視之為瓜分國家的開始，於是阿塔圖爾克在薩姆松擔任軍事代表展開全省巡查，之後地方游擊隊叢生，1920年6月希軍占領埃德雷內同東色雷斯更令運動擴大。深層原因是鄂圖曼國家在戰後解體：蘇丹制被協約國保留但喪失實權，帝國領土被瓜分，摩澤爾的協約國佔領區、希臘對安納托利亞的野心、法國在西里西亞的委任統治，以及被武裝化的亞美尼亞團體，令安納托利亞多數民眾的生存空間同安全受到直接威脅。國民運動提出的綱領因此不僅是軍事上的民族自衛，還包括恢復被剝奪的司法、財政同稅收權力，建立以民族代表為基礎的政府。外部條件同樣關鍵：戰敗的德國需要維持中東影響力，願意提供顧問同裝備；蘇俄需要削弱西歐列強的陣地，願意以槍械換取土耳其在裏海同高加索方向的善意；鄂圖曼留下的軍火庫、鐵路網同技術人員，就是新軍的物質底子。
causeEn: The immediate spark was the occupation question in Anatolia. After the armistice the Ottoman Greek-inhabited provinces were carved up by the Allies; on 15 May 1919 Greek troops landed at İzmir under the cover of British, French and Italian warships, and Turkish nationalists read it as the start of a partition of the country, which is why Atatürk's arrival at Samsun and his tour of the province as military representative followed, then the multiplication of local guerrilla bands, and the Greek seizure of Edirne and Eastern Thrace in June 1920 widened the movement. The deeper cause was the dissolution of the Ottoman state after the war: the sultanate was kept by the Allies but had lost real power, the imperial territory was being partitioned, and the Allied occupation zones in Thrace, the Greek designs on Anatolia, the French mandate in Cilicia and the armed Armenian formations all directly threatened the living space and security of most Anatolians. The programme of the national movement was therefore not only military self-defence but also the recovery of the judicial, fiscal and tax powers that had been stripped away, and the building of a government based on national representation. External conditions mattered just as much: defeated Germany wanted to keep influence in the Middle East and was ready to supply advisers and equipment, Soviet Russia wanted to weaken the western powers' position and offered arms in exchange for Turkish goodwill towards the Caucasus and the Caspian, and the arms depots, railway network and technicians left behind by the Ottomans became the material base of the new army.
impact: 這場戰爭終結了鄂圖曼帝國。1922年11月1日蘇丹制廢除，1924年3月3日哈里發制廢止，安卡拉同君士坦丁堡分道揚鑣，新國家在制度上同舊王朝切割。軍事上，國民軍完成了歐洲式參謀部的重建：總參謀部體系、軍團制、戰役偵察同集中砲兵在薩卡里亞同大攻勢中被驗證，同德國顧問團建立的合作亦令土耳其軍隊在此後數十年保持歐陸式參謀傳統。工業同教育上，戰爭刺激安納托利亞本地的軍械維修同小型製造，軍械工廠同鐵路沿線的兵站體系成為新國家的骨架；戰後重新分配的援助，同德國顧問留下的技術人員，又將國民軍的編制固定落嚟。國際上，土耳其放棄泛土耳其主義的擴張路徑，轉向在既有邊界內鞏固主權，洛桑談判中放棄對外族裔的申索，改以1923年1月30日簽訂的交換條約處理安納托利亞同愛琴海兩岸的居民移動，國家機器從此以人口同質化為前提運作。蘇俄得到通往高加索同裏海的通道，可以在1920年代鞏固巴庫同外高加索；德國則在土耳其保留長期的技術同軍事影響，一九三〇年代土耳其購置德國武器的傳統由此起頭。歐洲的觀感亦隨之逆轉：戰前被視為垂死東方的病夫，戰後以小國擊敗大國的姿態躋身列強之列。
impactEn: The war ended the Ottoman Empire. The sultanate was abolished on 1 November 1922 and the caliphate on 3 March 1924, and the sharp line between Ankara and Constantinople left the new state institutionally cut from the old dynasty. Militarily the national movement completed the rebuilding of a European-style staff system: the general staff structure, the corps organisation, battlefield reconnaissance and concentrated artillery were all validated at Sakarya and in the Great Offensive, and the working relationship with the German mission kept the Turkish army on a continental staff tradition for decades. Industrially and in education, the fighting stimulated local repair workshops and small manufacture along the railway lines, and the ordnance works and the depot system along the tracks became the skeleton of the new country; the redistributed aid after the war and the technicians left by the German mission fixed the organisation of the national army in place. Internationally, Turkey abandoned the expansionist path of pan-Turkism and consolidated sovereignty inside existing borders; at Lausanne it gave up its claims over the populations of the former multi-ethnic empire and settled the movement of people between Anatolia and the Aegean with the exchange convention of 30 January 1923, so that the state machine from then on worked on the premise of a homogeneous population. Soviet Russia obtained the corridor towards the Caucasus and the Caspian and could consolidate Baku and the Transcaucasia in the 1920s; Germany kept a long-term technical and military influence in Turkey, and the tradition of buying German weapons in the 1930s began there. The European perception reversed as well: a country written off before the war as a dying sick man of the East entered the ranks of the powers as the small state that had beaten a great one.
result: 結果是國民運動的完全勝利。1922年8月26日大攻勢之後，希臘在安納托利亞的戰區崩潰，陶盧皮納爾一役希軍被截成兩段，國民軍佔領埃斯凱希爾、屈塔希亞、阿菲永卡拉利同安納托利亞西部廣大地區，9月9日進入伊茲密爾，9月12日希軍集團軍正式解散，之後希軍殘部同盟軍船隊撤出小亞細亞。希臘王國因此失去在小亞細亞的立足點，安納托利亞的戰爭反而加速了希臟同希臘之間的和解同1923年9月的人口交換協議。安卡拉政府於10月11日迫使對方在穆達尼亞簽訂停戰協議，1923年7月24日簽訂的《洛桑條約》確認了新國家的邊界同主權，條約亦廢除了對列強的投降條款；1923年10月29日大國民議會宣告土耳其共和國成立，阿塔圖爾克出任第一任總統，參謀總長伊納尼其後接掌國家最高職位。從兵器的角度看，戰爭的勝負並不是由某一種槍械決定：Gew 88這類五發彈匣的栓動步槍在全場戰爭中提供的是可以讓數十萬人持續作戰的量產步兵火力，真正改變局勢的是把佢哋組織起嚟的參謀體系、塹壕同砲兵結合的防禦，以及1922年8月嗰次集中全軍的縱深攻勢。
resultEn: The outcome was a complete victory for the national movement. After the Great Offensive of 26 August 1922 the Greek position in Anatolia came apart; at Dumlupınar on 30 August the Greek army was cut in two, the nationalist forces occupied Eskişehir, Kütahya, Afyonkarahisar and wide areas of western Anatolia, entered İzmir on 9 September, and on 12 September the Greek Army of Smyrna was formally dissolved, after which the Greek remnants and the allied fleets withdrew from Asia Minor. Greece lost its footing in Asia Minor, and the Anatolian war itself sped up the reconciliation between Greece and Turkey and the population exchange agreement of September 1923. The Ankara Government forced the other side to sign the Mudanya armistice on 11 October, and the Treaty of Lausanne of 24 July 1923 confirmed the borders and sovereignty of the new state while wiping out the capitulation clauses imposed on it; on 29 October 1923 the Grand National Assembly proclaimed the Republic of Turkey, with Atatürk as its first president, and the chief of the general staff İnönü later succeeded to the highest office. Judged from the point of view of the weapon, no single firearm decided the war: a five-round magazine bolt-action rifle such as the Gewehr 88 supplied throughout the campaign the mass-produced infantry fire that allowed hundreds of thousands of men to keep fighting, and what actually turned the situation was the staff system that organised those rifles, the defensive combination of trenches and artillery, and the concentrated all-arms offensive of August 1922.
